svg.title: AdventurePad Skin Authoring Reference v2
svg.desc: Canonical editable source with separate ARTWORK, GUIDES, LABELS, and REGISTRATION layers.

g.text: Documentation only — create and submit artwork with AdventurePad-Skin-Template-v2.png.
Exact display canvas 1920×1080 px — every actual runtime game viewport is protected
Bitmap fills the display, then SkinSurroundView clipOutRect(viewport).
No pixel is guaranteed artwork-visible: full-screen 16:9 hides all art.
4:3 leaves 240 px per side; 16:10 leaves 96 px per side on this canvas.
ScummVM GUI/overlay reports full display protected (no surround).
Split View may expand the upper crop and changes the protected rectangle.
Potential surround only; never place required information here
Exact canvas 1240×1080 px; source constants shown in dp/fractions; reference scenario is explicitly conditional
Reference scenario shown: safeDrawing = 0 px, density = 2 px/dp
Trackpad gesture area (excluding current L/R overlays)
Touch outer padding: horizontal 12 dp; vertical 3 dp.
L/R height = clamp(22% of surface, 56 dp, 88 dp).
Utility row padding: horizontal 12 dp; vertical 4 dp.
Companion and Settings each use separate NORMAL/PRESSED assets shown below.
No connection-status text is rendered on this screen.
Immersive hides native labels, borders, marker, and button chrome.
Trackpad is weighted; height changes with insets/window size.
Live mirrored crop occupies dynamic top height; remaining native trackpad and utility row stay responsive
Reference scenario shown: safeDrawing = 0 px, density = 2 px/dp
LIVE MIRRORED CONTENT — example height 314 px
splitRatio is 0.05…0.95; default 0.75; snapped to source pixels.
Example: 4:3 source, 0.75 split, zero inset → 314 px panel.
NO ARTWORK MAY COVER THIS REGION
Fixed runtime-owned geometry: full immersive surface, title at top, Notes left, Walkthrough right
Reference scenario shown: safeDrawing = 0 px, density = 2 px/dp
HEADER 72 dp • CLOSE HIT TARGET IS RUNTIME-OWNED
NOTES BUTTON — FIXED HIT AREA 286×96 dp
WALKTHROUGH BUTTON — FIXED HIT AREA 286×96 dp
OPEN AREA — reserved for future fixed Companion actions
Paint the Companion title and surrounding decoration into this background.
Dedicated Notes/Walkthrough normal/pressed assets supply action art and labels.
Hit areas are fixed by AdventurePad; artists never define interaction coordinates.
Dashed green areas are recommended 16 dp essential-art margins.
Standard supplies visible header/buttons; runtime still owns semantics and press input.
Standard: opaque native page. Immersive: artwork is the page; native editor remains keyboard-sensitive
Reference scenario shown: safeDrawing = 0 px, density = 2 px/dp
Page overlay = 94% of safeDrawing bounds, centered
IME/keyboard may shrink this region upward (adjustResize)
Keep this region pale and low contrast; native content padding is 16 dp.
Done is the keyboard IME action, not an in-page artwork button.
Text/placeholder/cursor/outline remain native and dark in Immersive.
Standard: opaque native page. Immersive: artwork is the page; native controls remain conditional
Reference scenario shown: safeDrawing = 0 px, density = 2 px/dp
Page overlay = 94% of safeDrawing bounds, centered
Reader / Contents / Search results — scrolling live content
Immersive reading area: keep pale/quiet; dark native text; 16 dp H / 12 dp V padding
Row padding 8 dp horizontal / 4 dp vertical; back/close 48×48 dp min.
READER/SEARCH/CONTENTS are content-width, 40 dp min height.
MORE is 40 dp min height; menus overlay dynamically.
Search, contents and reader settings can add/reflow native UI.
GESTURE CONTENT IS NATIVE • ARTWORK IS NON-INTERACTIVE
96 px suggested nine-slice borders • keep essential detail out of stretchable centre
Nine-slice source 1240×360 — runtime draws border patches only around Companion-family pages
CENTER PATCH OMITTED BY RUNTIME — native content remains visible
KEEP CENTER TRANSPARENT • ARTWORK IS NON-INTERACTIVE
GREEN OUTER BAND / AMBER GUIDES = 64 px SUGGESTED NINE-SLICE BORDER
1200×675 • opaque • contain • never rendered as UI
ASSET STATE: NORMAL — VISUAL CHANGE ONLY
ASSET STATE: PRESSED — VISUAL CHANGE ONLY
ASSET STATE: NORMAL — VISUAL CHANGE ONLY
ASSET STATE: PRESSED — VISUAL CHANGE ONLY
